subject.title: sessions_send from visible webchat leaks internal replies via announce path and rebinds target sessions to webchat

question: Should waited peer-session `sessions_send` from a visible source keep the current visible A2A announce behavior, or should it enforce a strict internal handoff that cannot announce raw target replies or adopt visible webchat context?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally support peer A2A announce delivery, but this report describes a security/session-state boundary where internal replies become visible and mutate target routing state.

options.title: Define strict internal handoff
options.body: Make visible-source internal sends suppress raw target announce delivery by default and add focused route-preservation tests.

options.title: Keep announce-capable behavior
options.body: Document `sessions_send` as an announce-capable handoff and add guardrails so target delivery context is not silently rebound.

options.title: Split by explicit mode
options.body: Preserve current peer announce behavior while adding an explicit internal-only mode or separate primitive for strict delegation.

recommendation.title: Define strict internal handoff
recommendation.body: Make visible-source internal sends suppress raw target announce delivery by default and add focused route-preservation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sessions_send routing history makes this the best available routing candidate from the inspected owner signals.
